sn34.5:1.4: “Support” is _ārammaṇa_, namely the different subjects of meditation. This is the only term in this list that does not appear elsewhere in the early canon.It does not mean “object”, which is exclusively a later sense, derived from the (again later) use of the _kasiṇa_ as an “object” or “disk” on which to focus attention (for the Sutta usage, see [mn77:24.11]()).
